offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures commercial plumbing fixtures, drinking water coolers and filtration, and water control products for non-residential buildings. Sells mainly to contractors, building owners and facility operators, through distributors, dealers and direct sales.

primary_products.value: drinking water coolers and fountains; faucets and sinks; flush valves; floor drains; water filtration systems; backflow preventers

primary_services.value: product installation support; water quality testing; aftermarket parts and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Plumbing contractors, commercial building owners, facility managers, architects, and foodservice operators; B2G: Public school districts, universities, and government facility managers

end_markets.value: commercial construction; education; healthcare; foodservice; hospitality; water utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: Plumbing fixtures, drinking water coolers, filters, and valves sold to contractors and distributors; service fees: Aftermarket parts, filter replacement, and repair services for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Manufactures fixtures and water products from purchased metal, plastic, and components, sold to distributors and contractors; brand owner: Designs and markets water products under its own brands made partly by contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily North America, with sales and manufacturing in Europe, Asia, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: plumbing fixtures, drinking water coolers and filtration, flush and drain products sharing commercial building customers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Plumbing wholesale distributors and independent dealers serving contractors; direct sales: Direct sales teams selling to large institutional and national accounts; partners / resellers: Water treatment and foodservice equipment resellers and installation partners
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: plumbing codes, NSF/ANSI drinking water certification, lead-free material standards, and Safe Drinking Water Act rules

notes: Segment mix and geographic split are approximate from general knowledge.
